a.lede: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
a.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now

b.lede: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.
b.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
